title: Podcast metadata output
description: Dataset rows for shows and optional episodes (metadata only — No transcription). SUMMARY/OUTPUT JSON in KV.

results.title: Shows & episodes
results.description: Default dataset: kind=show|episode rows with title, artist, feedUrl, genres, enclosureUrl, duration, showNotesHash. No email/contacts. Views: overview.

summary.title: SUMMARY report
summary.description: Key-value store record SUMMARY (JSON): show/episode counts, charged events, peakMemoryMb, noTranscription flags.

output.title: Run summary (OUTPUT)
output.description: Key-value store record OUTPUT (JSON): same run summary as SUMMARY.
